top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Plan for extreme weather conditions (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(G))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational handbook lacked a section on promoting indoor play during extreme weather conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not provided parents with a copy of the parent's rights form 2987 as required.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff files reviewed did not have the required Health and Safety training topic certificates for the last full year of training.

top_violation_types.title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguishers have not been inspected monthly.

top_violation_types.title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing information on the parents receiving the operational policies.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver, who also serves as a van driver, did not have proof of current first aid.
